title: Dustfall
summary: Escort Marrow's survey team (Kindred engineers, the allied encounter survey-team: they walk to the hull and back on their own) to a centuries-old Kindred hull. The manifest says "Captain: Marrow, I." (marrow-manifest, marrow-grief). Then hold off what comes out of the hold. Fails if the team dies (survey-team-lost).

objectives.text: Meet Marrow's survey team at their camp
Escort the team to the signal under the dunes
Hold off what comes out of the hold

notes: The escort: an allied faction encounter rather than spawned units, because no condition can count units of one kind (units counts every combat unit). Its doneFlag survey-team-lost is exact.
